main_goal: Predict the five fastest rising A-share stocks across five trading sessions, without imputing unverified full-market rank.
root_causes: During National Day holiday, strict verifier erroneously expected 2026-10-02 security date rather than last valid trading session 2026-09-30.
Tencent intraday and snapshot price agreement does not replace missing independent daily close checks.
Full-universe 61-session daily K and industry features are not yet adapted to V8 rank engine.
GitHub contents fetch of 2.8MB returned empty string; GitHub fetch_blob by SHA did recover full original snapshot.
repair_plan: Make cross-check calendar aware and resolve prior valid exchange session before verifying minute or daily-K data.
Use daily-K failover and record 20 independent daily closes for the stratified samples.
Cache and incrementally adapt >=61 genuine sessions for each eligible A-share and as-of industry classification.
Execute actual rank(data) over the complete eligible universe, save hashes and full ranking with create-only frozen cohort, then score D5 out-of-sample.
success_criteria: All eligible A-shares have sufficient as-of daily history and sector, 20/20 sample cross-check passes with independent daily K, full ranking hash is persisted, forecast frozen by 08:50 next eligible run.
risk: Avoid converting a proposed data pipeline fix into an unproven improvement in trading accuracy.
privacy: Only public market data; contains no account or personal holdings.
